lines.japanese: 「なに。あいつ姉ちゃんか妹いんの」
lines.english: “What? He has a sister? Older or younger?”

lines.japanese: 「妹がいんだって。あんま仲良くはないみたいだけど、ＬＲさんいわく、翔お兄ちゃんはそのことをとても残念に思ってるって」
lines.english: “A younger sister, apparently. They don’t get along all that well, but LR says her big brother Kakeru takes it pretty hard.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: どっかで聞いたような話だ。
lines.english: That story sounded familiar.

lines.japanese: タカシと小鳩。
lines.english: Takashi and Kobato.

lines.japanese: どこのお兄ちゃんも大変だ。
lines.english: Being a big brother was hard work wherever you went.

lines.japanese: だがそれは兄として産みおとされたあいつの義務だ。その役割は責任持って果たしてもらわなければ困る。俺は俺のやり方でそれを支援する。すげえ重要な話。
lines.english: But he’d been born her older brother; that came with a duty. He had to carry it out properly, and I would back him up in my own way. This mattered. A hell of a lot.
“Hayato...?”

lines.japanese: 気付いたら俺は険しい顔をしていた。香田が機嫌をうかがうように覗きこんでいる。
lines.english: Before I knew it, I was scowling. Koda peered into my face, trying to gauge my mood.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、なに」
lines.english: “Hm? What?”

lines.japanese: 「や、あの、あんまり心配だったら、隼人君の方でもサイト確認してもらえないかなって。ほら、あのヘンな言い回しじゃん？　単に私が読みちがってるだけかもしんないし」
lines.english: “Well, if you're really worried, could you check the site yourself? You know how strangely they write. Maybe I just read it wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「そもそも書き込み自体が、ネットによくあるただの悪戯って可能性もあるし。そのへん隼人君の目で見極めてくれたら、安心できる方に転がるかも」
lines.english: “The post itself might be an ordinary internet prank, too. If you took a look and made the call, maybe we'd find out there's nothing to worry about.”
“Yeah...”

lines.japanese: たしかに手元の情報は不確定すぎる。実際に大司教の「犯罪予告」とやらを確かめた方がいいかもしれない。場合によっちゃその場で通報だ。
lines.english: Admittedly, the information I had was far too uncertain. It might be best to read the archbishop's supposed threat myself. Depending on what it said, I could report it then and there.

lines.japanese: 「ん、分かった。じゃ、そうするわ」
lines.english: “All right. I'll do that.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとっ？」
lines.english: “Really?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「はー！　よし、それじゃ明日、またあのネカフェに行こっ」
lines.english: “Whew! Great. Then let's go back to that internet café tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「え……おまえも来んの」
lines.english: “Wait... You're coming too?”
“Oh... Is that bad?”

lines.japanese: 「あー？　ああ……」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh...”

lines.japanese: 俺はすこし首を捻って考えてみた。
lines.english: I tilted my head and gave it some thought.

lines.japanese: たしかに、まだひとりでインターネットの機械を立ちあげるのは心もとない。
lines.english: It was true that I still didn't trust myself to start up an internet machine alone.

lines.japanese: しかし香田と、というのはどうなんだ。
lines.english: But going with Koda was another question.

lines.japanese: 自惚れじゃなければ、やつは明らかに諦めていない。俺は一度やつを拒否したのだから、その気もないのに期待させるような行為はよろしくないんじゃないだろうか。
lines.english: Unless I was flattering myself, she clearly hadn't given up. I had already turned her down. If I had no intention of returning her feelings, wasn't it wrong to do anything that might keep her hoping?

lines.japanese: なあ、どう思うよ。さっきからチラッチラ、チラッチラこっち気にしまくりの森里くん。
lines.english: Well, Morisato? What do you think? You've spent this whole conversation sneaking look after look after look our way.

lines.japanese: 「だめならいいけど」
lines.english: “If you don't want me to, that's okay.”

lines.japanese: 「まァ、べつにどっちでも」
lines.english: “Well, either way's fine with me.”

lines.japanese: 俺は逃げた。我ながらロクでもない男だなあと思う。
lines.english: I ran. Even I had to admit I was a lousy man.

lines.japanese: 「やった、行く行く、バリバリ行く！」
lines.english: “Yes! I'm going! Hell yes, I'm going!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、明日１０時半。ヤナポリ広場。無理だったらひとりで行くからいいよ」
lines.english: “Tomorrow at ten-thirty, then. Yanapoli Plaza. If you can't make it, don't worry. I'll go alone.”

lines.japanese: 一方的に告げてハゲたちのもとへ戻った。
lines.english: I told her that without waiting for an answer, then went back to the bald guys.

lines.japanese: 戻ったら戻ったで、急に俺を見なくなる森里くん。
lines.english: And the moment I came back, Morisato suddenly stopped looking at me.

lines.japanese: やっぱ青春ってめんどくせえな。
lines.english: Youth really was a pain in the ass.
